summary: The checkout page exhibits low text contrast in the header glass bar and lacks a backdrop scrim for the sheet dialog, causing visual collision with underlying content.

issues.title: Low contrast header text
issues.description: Header labels inside the glass container lack sufficient luminance in dark mode.
issues.evidence: Text 'Praxis Cloud · Checkout' and 'Sandbox · test mode' blends into the dark background.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color token brightness for dark theme.

issues.title: Missing backdrop scrim
issues.description: The modal sheet renders directly over page content without a background overlay.
issues.evidence: The sheet overlaps the order summary and API calls panel without dimming or blurring background elements.
issues.suggestion: Add a dimmed backdrop scrim behind the sheet to isolate focus.
